prose.text: - **Ordinary gates.** The non-operator gates run in /implement P2 and the wrap light gate. - **The live block (steps 8–11).** It is the operator's slot, driven by the agent only after the slot is granted and   the hands-off instruction is relayed (step 7). It is never fired by the gate tool.   - Its legs are `leg = 'live'`.   - Its readings (census, hashes, pre-leg counts, freezes, quiet windows, end-line check) are `leg = 'operator'`: one     point-in-time reading each, recorded in `evidence/round-ledger.md` and never re-run by the wrap. Pulse's binary     may be rebuilt by another session afterwards.   - Each leg is preceded by its non-priming `conductor preconditions` probe. There is no `boot` entry anywhere. - **Launching `pulse-app`** is step 8's agent act on the slot (memory "Agent may launch pulse-app when directed"). It   is not an entry, and its stop is the agent's at step 10, by PID + CreationDate. - **Evidence producers.**   - `evidence/p075-leg.txt` and `evidence/h.jsonl` are produced by entries carrying `artifact`.   - `pulse-{h,d,r,f}.jsonl` and `round-ledger.md` are hand-authored records written at steps 10–11 from the round's     outputs. They are slices of the live data dir, which no re-run can reproduce.   - What re-runs is the two harvest targets, which grade the digest-pinned files. - **Self-verify:** none. No Conductor UI surface or `ui/dist` input changes. - **CI:** read by the operator pass. The prior wrap's run took 559 s wall (CI#36946764116, Setup 5a), so   `--wait 1200` covers it.
